guidebook.intro: Nyumya enfumo za Buganda mu Lungereza: Wakayima, Kintu ne Nnambi, n’esomo lyazo.

tips.title: Wakayima
body: Mu Lungereza Wakayima ayitibwa **the hare**. Enfumo zinyumizibwa mu byayita: **The hare was very clever. The hare tricked the elephant.** (**trick → tricked**).

tips.title: Okunyonyola abantu
body: Omuntu omupya mu lufumo omunyonyola amangu: **Kintu married Nnambi, the daughter of Ggulu.** Era: **Walumbe (Death)**, **Ggulu, the king of the sky**.

tips.title: Esomo ly’olufumo
body: **What does this story teach us?** — **It teaches us that wisdom beats strength.** Oba: **The moral of the story is …**

culture.title: Okunyumya nate
body: Bw’onyumiza mukwano gwo ow’ebweru olufumo lwa Buganda mu Lungereza, amanya gaabwe galeke nga bwe gali: **Kintu**, **Nnambi**, **Walumbe**. Gano ge gafuula olufumo olwafe.
